facts.fact: AdWave states that average CTV CPM across small-business platforms is running 4-8% below late-2025 levels in most metros for May and June.
facts.quote: Average CTV CPM across small-business platforms is running 4-8% below late-2025 levels in most metros for May and June.

facts.fact: AdWave states that by the start of summer 2026, more than 35% of small businesses with monthly ad budgets above $1,500 had run at least one CTV campaign, up from roughly 18% at the same point in 2024.
facts.unit: % of small businesses with monthly ad budgets above $1,500
facts.quote: By the start of summer 2026, more than 35% of small businesses with monthly ad budgets above $1,500 had run at least one CTV campaign, up from roughly 18% at the same point in 2024.

facts.fact: AdWave states that subscription platforms have brought entry-level CTV access to the $50-$500 per month range.
facts.quote: Subscription platforms have brought entry-level CTV access to the $50-$500/month range

facts.fact: AdWave states that a single 30-second TV spot that once required a $5,000 production budget can now be generated in 2-5 minutes from a website URL using AI creative tools.
facts.quote: What used to require a $5,000 production budget for a single 30-second spot can now be generated in 2-5 minutes from a website URL.

facts.fact: AdWave gives an example summer 2026 plan for a local home services business with a $4,000 monthly budget, allocating $1,200 to Google Ads (search + local services).
facts.quote: Google Ads (search + local services): $1,200

facts.fact: In AdWave's example summer 2026 plan for a local home services business with a $4,000 monthly budget, $1,200 is allocated to CTV.
In AdWave's example summer 2026 plan for a local home services business with a $4,000 monthly budget, $900 is allocated to Meta (Facebook + Instagram).
facts.quote: Meta (Facebook + Instagram): $900

facts.fact: AdWave states that small businesses making the shift to coordinated multi-channel single-budget planning report 15-30% efficiency gains over the prior year on the same total budget.
facts.quote: Small businesses making this shift report 15-30% efficiency gains over the prior year on the same total budget.

facts.fact: AdWave states that retail and service businesses are starting holiday promotions 7-14 days earlier than they did in 2024.
facts.quote: Retail and service businesses are starting promotion 7-14 days earlier than they did in 2024

facts.fact: AdWave states that the 10 days before a holiday consistently produce better conversion rates than the holiday week itself.
facts.quote: The 10 days before a holiday consistently produce better conversion rates than the holiday week itself.

facts.fact: AdWave claims that a specific offer such as '20% off through Father's Day' outperforms a brand reminder by 2-4x on conversion.
facts.quote: "20% off through Father's Day" outperforms "Happy Father's Day from your local hardware store" by 2-4x on conversion.

facts.fact: AdWave states that more small businesses are routinely capturing a 4-week pre-campaign baseline of inquiries, calls, foot traffic, and online conversions before comparing against campaign weeks.
facts.quote: More small businesses are routinely capturing a 4-week pre-campaign baseline

facts.fact: AdWave states that even if only 20-40% of TV-influenced viewers use a QR code or vanity URL, the directly attributed conversions become measurable.
facts.unit: % of TV-influenced viewers using QR or vanity URL
facts.quote: Even if only 20-40% of TV-influenced viewers use the QR or vanity URL

facts.fact: AdWave states that the friendly summer inventory window starts to close in mid-July as fall political and retail advertisers begin pre-buying.
facts.quote: The friendly inventory window starts to close in mid-July as fall political and retail advertisers begin pre-buying.

facts.fact: CTV CPMs rise 15-25% in competitive markets from mid-July through the election, according to the page.
facts.quote: CTV CPMs rise 15-25% in competitive markets from mid-July through the election

facts.fact: May-June CTV CPMs are 4-8% below late-summer CPM rates, according to the page.
facts.quote: May-June CTV CPMs are 4-8% below late-summer rates, and inventory is friendlier.

facts.fact: Subscription-tier CTV platforms have entry points of $50 to $500 per month.
facts.quote: subscription-tier platforms ($50-$500/month entry points)

facts.fact: In some mid-sized markets, co-op patterns see 4-8 small businesses pooling budget to run local-pride CTV campaigns.
facts.quote: where 4-8 small businesses pool budget to run local-pride CTV campaigns

facts.fact: CPMs typically settle quickly by early November, when the holiday push begins.
facts.quote: By early November, CPMs typically settle quickly and the holiday push begins.

facts.fact: The page recommends locking in CTV campaign placements by early July, before the political ad surge.
facts.quote: locking in CTV campaign placements by early July (before the surge)

facts.fact: The page cites an example of pairing a July 4th festival sponsorship with two weeks of CTV in surrounding ZIPs.
facts.quote: pairs it with two weeks of CTV in the surrounding ZIPs

facts.fact: The page recommends capturing four weeks of pre-campaign performance as a baseline before each flight.
facts.quote: Capture your 4 weeks pre-campaign performance on the metrics you care about

facts.fact: The page recommends holding Meta spend steady for the first CTV test cycle of 60-90 days.
facts.quote: Hold Meta steady for the first CTV test cycle (60-90 days)

facts.fact: For back-to-school campaigns, the page says early August is too late and recommends starting awareness creative in mid-July.
facts.quote: early August is too late. Start awareness and consideration creative in mid-July

facts.fact: The page states that average CTV CPM is slightly below 2024 levels in most metros.
facts.quote: Average CPM is also slightly below 2024 levels in most metros, though that gap may close in fall.
